clue.text: Squabble with unbaked sort of food

indicators.note: sort of suggests a version of the letters, so the two words are rearranged together

explanation.surface: Someone argues with a person over a dish that never went in the oven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' tells you to shuffle SQUABBLE and UNBAKED together; 'with' just joins them. Bubble and squeak is a British dish of fried leftover potato and cabbage.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a traditional British fry-up dish of leftover vegetables, so a kind of food.

clue.text: Christian, not penny, with fifth-rate fabric

indicators.note: not says the coin's abbreviation is taken away from the churchgoer's word

parts.note: a Baptist is a member of a Christian denomination
P is the abbreviation for a penny in British money
E is the fifth grade, as in A to E ratings

explanation.surface: A Christian without money ends up with shoddy cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes P (penny) from BAPTIST, leaving BATIST; then add E for 'fifth-rate'.
explanation.definitionFit: Batiste is a fine, light cotton or linen cloth, a type of textile.

clue.text: Mixture takes long time, it has been prepared by infusion and fermentation

definitions.text: it has been prepared by infusion and fermentation

parts.note: a brew is a concoction or mixture
an age is a very long time

explanation.surface: A concoction takes ages to make by steeping and fermenting.
explanation.definitionFit: Brewage is a brewed drink, made by steeping malt and letting it ferment.

clue.text: After which comes the following answer?

definitions.text: After which comes the following answer?

parts.words: After which comes the following answer?
parts.note: a question worded to steer the person replying, so the reply that follows is the one wanted

explanation.surface: A puzzle about what precedes a reply.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a riddle about order, but 'following' means falling in with what the questioner wants.
explanation.definitionFit: A question phrased to prompt a particular reply, as in a courtroom, is one the reply then obeys.

clue.text: With no earthly connection whatsoever

parts.note: taken literally, having no contact with the ground at all, as in flight

explanation.surface: Something utterly unrelated to anything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no earthly connection' sounds like an idiom for irrelevance; read literally it means off the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Being carried in the air or in flight means not touching the ground.

clue.text: Leave much sand

explanation.surface: An instruction to leave a beach.
explanation.definitionFit: To abandon is one sense; a vast arid sandy region such as the Sahara is the other.

clue.text: A fifties person?

parts.note: not someone from the 1950s but someone aged between fifty and fifty-nine

explanation.surface: Someone who belongs to the decade of rock and roll.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fifties' suggests the decade; it means a person's age.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin-derived word for someone in their sixth decade of life, aged fifty to fifty-nine.

clue.text: One constituent of the weather

parts.note: bad weather is called the ..., so one part of it is a single one of those

explanation.surface: Part of a forecast, like rain or wind.
explanation.definitionFit: Stormy weather is called 'the elements', and a basic component of anything is one of these.

clue.text: Kiln too involved with explosive unit

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled together, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A kiln gets caught up with a measure of blast power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' shuffles the letters of KILN TOO; 'with' joins.
explanation.definitionFit: A kiloton measures blast yield equal to a thousand tons of TNT.

clue.text: Bull — he's in the reference book

indicators.note: in places the pronoun with its verb inside the star sign

parts.note: Taurus is the zodiac sign of the bull
taken as written, the apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A bull and a man found inside a reference work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts HES inside TAURUS, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesaurus is a book listing synonyms, used for looking words up.

clue.text: Model thought to be by lake

parts.note: an idea is a thought
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A model is thinking of being beside a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A perfect example or standard to follow, as a noun, is a model.

clue.text: Religious instructor crawled in front of unit

indicators.note: in front of puts the swimming word before the numeral in the across answer

parts.note: swam, as in did the front crawl stroke
I is the Roman numeral one, a single unit

explanation.surface: A spiritual teacher crawls ahead of a group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crawled' looks like moving on all fours; it is the swimming stroke.
explanation.definitionFit: A swami is a Hindu holy man and religious teacher.

clue.text: When asked for there is less than one petition

indicators.note: less than takes the word one minus its last letter

parts.note: a request is a petition

explanation.surface: Something given when demanded, though fewer than one petition exists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'less than one' cuts the last letter from ONE to leave ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplied when someone requests it, that is, on demand.

clue.text: Appearing to be joining expedition leader in front

indicators.note: in front puts that letter before the joining word
leader picks the first letter of the word expedition

parts.note: merging means joining together

explanation.surface: A leader of an expedition comes forward to join up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expedition leader' gives E, placed 'in front' of MERGING.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming into view is emerging, synonym for appearing.

clue.text: Picture nothing has been removed from box

indicators.note: says the letter for zero is taken out of the drawing

parts.note: a cartoon is a drawn picture
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Nothing has been taken from a picture box.
explanation.definitionFit: A carton is a cardboard container, a kind of box.

clue.text: Female hit dandy with burning torch

parts.note: lam means to hit hard
a beau is a fashionable dandy

explanation.surface: A woman strikes a fop with a flaming torch.
explanation.definitionFit: A flambeau is a flaming torch, from the French for flame.

clue.text: After a time dust was kicked around while in breeding establishment

indicators.note: After puts the rearranged dust after the article and time
kicked around suggests scattering, so the letters of dust are rearranged

explanation.surface: Dust was kicked up at a stud farm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was kicked around' shuffles DUST to STUD, placed after A and T.
explanation.definitionFit: A stallion at stud is kept for breeding, so it is placed at a breeding farm.

clue.text: A sea-song audible in central Ghana

indicators.note: audible says the words are as they sound when spoken

parts.note: a shanty is a sailors' song

explanation.surface: A sailors' song heard in the middle of Ghana.
explanation.walkthrough: A SHANTY spoken sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashanti is a region and historic kingdom in the middle of Ghana.

clue.text: Some of the course is microanalysis of earthquakes

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a course studies earthquakes in detail.
explanation.definitionFit: Seismic is the adjective for tremors and earth movements.

clue.text: Civic dignitary plants tree on island

parts.note: an alder is a tree
Man is the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: A mayor plants a tree on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Man is a British crown dependency in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: An alderman is a senior member of a town council.

clue.text: Swallow individual cocktail

parts.note: a martin is a bird of the swallow family
I is a single person, oneself

explanation.surface: Gulp down one's own cocktail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swallow' looks like a verb about drinking; it is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A martini is a gin and vermouth drink.

clue.text: Such a price is in name only

explanation.surface: A price that exists only on paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A token price is tiny; something existing in title only is nominal.

clue.text: Both started loitering inside car

indicators.note: inside places the letter within the car word

parts.note: a coupe is a two-door car

indicators.note: started picks the first letter of loitering

explanation.surface: Two people loiter inside a car.
explanation.definitionFit: Two together, a pair, means both of them.

clue.text: Hardly bad weather!

parts.note: hardly read as in a hard manner, weather made of hard ice pellets

explanation.surface: An understatement about mild weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hardly' seems to mean scarcely; it means hard, of ice.
explanation.definitionFit: A storm in which frozen pellets fall is rough weather indeed.

clue.text: Jack goes to the edge completely full

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, as is an AB, able seaman
rim means edge

explanation.surface: A sailor walks to the edge, full up.
explanation.definitionFit: Filled to the top, brimming, means full.

clue.text: Single doctor in northern Ireland initially in the clouds

indicators.note: in puts the single doctor between the two initials
initially takes the first letters of northern and Ireland

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one, single
MB is a Bachelor of Medicine degree, a doctor

explanation.surface: One doctor is working in Northern Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' gives N and I, and 'in' places I + MB between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Nimbus clouds bring rain; the plural refers to more than one.

clue.text: Exactness on price is variable

indicators.note: a variable thing changes, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Exactness about prices varies.
explanation.definitionFit: Precision is accuracy, the quality of being exact.

clue.text: I name study in order that is trivial

parts.note: con means to study or learn
sequential means following in order

explanation.surface: I name a study in order that is trivial.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of no importance is insignificant.
